offering_description.value: Provides advertising, media planning and buying, public relations and marketing services to large companies and brands. Works through a group of agency networks and specialist units, and is paid by clients through fees, commissions or project contracts.

primary_services.value: advertising; media buying; public relations; marketing consulting; digital commerce services

customer_segment.value: B2B: large brands, retailers and corporations in consumer, technology, healthcare and financial sectors; B2G: government agencies running public information campaigns

end_markets.value: consumer goods; automotive; technology; healthcare; financial services; retail

revenue_model.value: service fees: agency fees for creative, strategy and marketing work; commissions or management fees: media commissions and buying fees on client advertising spend; project or contract: campaign and project work under client contracts
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in client marketing budgets and sells creative, media and consulting services to brand owners

geography_served.value: global: Operates in many countries across the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: advertising, media, public relations, health and commerce marketing units that share clients and talent

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct client relationships with major brands and corporations; partners / resellers: media platforms and publishers used to place client advertising

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: advertising standards, consumer protection and data privacy rules in many countries

notes: Omnicom agreed in 2024 to acquire Interpublic Group, so the current combined scale and mix may differ from this description.
